title: Land of the free remember the land of bondage
html_source: The land of free is the United States, the land of bondage is Ireland, but this is a reference to the Jews in Egypt, the original land of bondage. It is very ironic that the Citizen is drawing parallels between the Irish and the Jews, while he is at the same time very anti-Semitic.
